requirement.normalizedRequirement: For longitudinally-framed plating (Omega <= 20 deg) when b >= s, t_net = 500*s*sqrt((AF*PPF_p*P_avg)/sigma_y)/(1 + s/(2*l)) [mm]. When b < s, t_net = 500*s*sqrt((AF*PPF_p*P_avg)/sigma_y)*sqrt(2*b/s - (b/s)^2)/(1 + s/(2*l)) [mm].
requirement.source: UR I2 Structural Requirements for Polar Class Ships
requirement.sourceText: In the case of longitudinally-framed plating (Omega <= 20 deg), when b >= s, the net thickness is t_net = 500*s*sqrt((AF*PPF_p*P_avg)/sigma_y)/(1 + s/(2*l)) [mm]. When b < s, the net thickness is t_net = 500*s*sqrt((AF*PPF_p*P_avg)/sigma_y)*sqrt(2*b/s - (b/s)^2)/(1 + s/(2*l)) [mm].
